findings.location: Planned production ownership lines 75-138 and AD-13 lines 286-290
findings.affected_requirement: Constitution III mandatory MapVulgataApiEndpoints registration; AD-13 authenticated create/status/resume surface; Story 12.4 SystemOwner activation and reporting boundary
findings.evidence: The plan adds Pass2ExecutionEndpoints but omits src/dotnet/Vulgata.Web/Api/ApiEndpointRegistrationExtensions.cs from its production ownership. The current host calls app.MapVulgataApiEndpoints() once (Program.cs:174), and that central mapper explicitly registers every existing API group (ApiEndpointRegistrationExtensions.cs:11-20). The generated tasks likewise assign T043 only the new endpoint/DTO/validator files and T044 Program/DI/appsettings, so the required Pass 2 routes have no owner for registration through MapVulgataApiEndpoints(). Leaving them unmapped fails AD-13; mapping them directly in Program would violate Constitution III's mandatory central registration rule.
findings.correction_outcome: Correct the plan's Web ownership and API composition design to include ApiEndpointRegistrationExtensions.cs and require the new plural Pass 2 group to be registered through MapVulgataApiEndpoints(). Regenerate tasks with the public API RED followed by one explicit GREEN owner for endpoint implementation and central registration, preserving 401/403/ownership-filtered 404 and ProblemDetails behavior.

findings.category: Parallel write ownership and TDD ordering
findings.affected_requirement: Task execution rule lines 13-18; Constitution IV test-first integration; deterministic independent task ownership
findings.evidence: The task graph declares T010 and T011 parallel while both write ExactCrossRepositoryResolutionTests.cs, T018 and T019 parallel while both write Pass2FlowPlanningTests.cs, and T030 and T032 parallel while both write Pass2StrictSubmissionTests.cs. These are direct same-file write collisions under the advertised parallel schedule. In addition, T004's new entity/contract tests are allowed to run in parallel with production contract/entity tasks T005 and T006, so the definition does not establish an observable RED before those GREEN changes even though its own execution rule says every executable behavior is test-first.
findings.correction_outcome: Regenerate tasks so no [P] tasks share a file: either split each test seam into distinct files or serialize the tasks. Explicitly classify T004's existing behavior as characterization and add separate RED owners for new contract/entity invariants, or require T004 to complete and record RED before T005/T006. Keep test and production ownership separate and update phase dependencies/parallel examples accordingly.

findings.location: T002, T030, and T035 lines 26, 122, and 133
findings.affected_requirement: FR-029 through FR-036; AD-9 strict two-function transport; quickstart definition/schema gate; exact business-logic/flow-v1 submission contract
findings.evidence: The accepted plan requires business-logic-flow-v1.schema.json to be projected by the production strict-schema machinery characterized in Story 12.3. The current Agents project embeds only the Story 12.3 code-logic schema, and DeepSeekStrictSchemaProjector loads that exact embedded resource. T002 owns Vulgata.Agents.csproj but says only to add/embed the prompt; T030 expects an external schema identity; T035 implements the strict declarations but owns neither the project file nor an explicit schema-resource binding. Consequently no task is accountable for embedding the accepted Business Logic schema exactly once and making the production Pass 2 projector load/verify that artifact rather than reconstructing or hardcoding a potentially divergent schema.
findings.correction_outcome: Assign one foundation task to embed specs/013-exact-cross-repository-flow-pass2/contracts/business-logic-flow-v1.schema.json in Vulgata.Agents.csproj with an exact logical resource name and tests for unique loading/hash/identity. Make T030's RED depend on that resource contract and make T035 consume it through the strict projector; do not duplicate the schema as hardcoded C# or prompt text.

findings.location: T038, T048, and traceability table lines 136, 171, and 223-228
findings.evidence: T038 claims and records SC-012 while running strict-wire, validation, and atomic test suites; those suites cannot establish SC-012's approved two-Repository live-provider outcome. T048 is the task that actually runs that qualification, but it neither explicitly owns SC-012 nor names a durable sanitized qualification evidence artifact. The traceability table maps SC-012 only to T030-T038, making completion evidence possible before the real criterion has run.
findings.correction_outcome: Move SC-012 ownership to T048, name the sanitized qualification evidence artifact and required success fields, and leave T038 responsible only for SC-007 through SC-010 plus the testable local portions of FR-029 through FR-037 and FR-042. Update the traceability table and final barrier dependency so SC-012 cannot be marked satisfied before live qualification succeeds.

summary: REVISE. Fresh combined definition review ran the required non-destructive SpecKit analysis against the pinned Story 12.4 boundary at 02f46cafb79391b4dd310bda9e8d387d8f332ec8. The specification remains source-grounded and internally coherent: all 43 Functional Requirements, 12 Success Criteria, five user stories, 24 acceptance scenarios, exact Custom RPC/safe HTTP narrowing, deterministic decision-versus-reusable-Edge identity, endpoint-centered Flow Groups, closed retrieve_code_logic, immutable Version Chains, all-and-only-used GENERATED_FROM provenance, partial completion, security/data stewardship, migration compatibility, and Story 12.5 exclusions are represented across the accepted plan and 49 tasks. No unresolved placeholder, duplicate requirement, terminology drift, ADR/context conflict, or missing high-level requirement was found. The delivery definition is not yet implementable as written because the plan omits the Constitution-mandated central API registration seam, the tasks contain three explicit parallel same-file collisions plus an ambiguous RED/GREEN foundation order, and no task owns exact runtime embedding/loading of the accepted business-logic/flow-v1 schema. SC-012 is also attributed to a pre-qualification test task instead of the live two-Repository qualification. Earliest ownership is plan for DR1-001 and tasks for DR1-002 through DR1-004; the specification does not require regeneration. No source, test, lifecycle, workflow-state, stage, commit, index, or Git history was modified; only this raw verdict artifact was created.
